jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.content: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Acme</strong></p><p>Acme builds workflow software for logistics teams in 40+ countries. We are a team of 350 people across New York, London and Berlin.</p></div><h3>The role</h3><p>We&rsquo;re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to own our shipment-tracking APIs (Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka).</p><h3>What you&#39;ll do</h3><ul><li>Design and operate high-throughput event pipelines</li><li>Mentor engineers &amp; lead technical design reviews</li></ul><h3>Location</h3><p>This is a fully remote role, but <strong>candidates must be located in the United States</strong> and able to work Eastern or Central time hours. We cannot hire outside the US at this time.</p><h3>Compensation</h3><p>The base salary range for this role is $150,000&ndash;$190,000 USD per year, plus equity.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Acme is an equal opportunity employer &amp; values diversity at our company.</p></div>

jobs.title: Platform Engineer, EMEA
jobs.content: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Acme</strong></p><p>Acme builds workflow software for logistics teams in 40+ countries. We are a team of 350 people across New York, London and Berlin.</p></div><h3>The role</h3><p>Join our Platform team to run Kubernetes infrastructure across AWS eu-west-1 and eu-central-1.</p><ul><li>5+ years with Kubernetes and Terraform</li><li>On-call rotation shared across the EMEA team</li></ul><h3>Where you can work</h3><p>Remote from anywhere in EMEA between UTC-1 and UTC+3. jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.content: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Acme</strong></p><p>Acme builds workflow software for logistics teams in 40+ countries. We are a team of 350 people across New York, London and Berlin.</p></div><h3>The role</h3><p>As a Product Designer you will shape the dispatcher experience end-to-end, from research to polished UI in Figma.</p><ul><li>3+ years of product design experience</li><li>A portfolio showing complex B2B workflows</li></ul><p>This role is hybrid, with 3 days a week in our London office.</p><p><strong>Please note: we are unable to sponsor visas for this role.</strong> Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Acme is an equal opportunity employer &amp; values diversity at our company.</p></div>
